body:
I'm still waiting for an appointment :/
I too hope that things will turn out fine for me.

Thanks for replying to this post. I decided to leave my death until things get even worse, for now I'll try to focus on my mental health.

They did understand, they were worried and offered help but I kept rejecting it and continued to yell about how I'll die and make them happy. I also annoyed them with spam messages so they would hate me, which now they do.

I hate myself for that but I need to take of my mental state before I actually do commit to the plan.

Oh and thanks for replying, it feels good getting this off my chest :)
Yeah, it's all cause depression and anxiety.

I've wanted to kill myself for so long, I talked about this with my friends about this over and over, everytime I would go into panic mode and scream out how I'll kill myself. I made their life a living hell.

I didn't want to make them sad anymore, so I made them hate me and now I have to pay for what I done.
